title: 第15章 再遇狗爷改第16章 少帮主改
slug: 凡人修仙谁能比我极阴更阴
content_zh:
小楼二层。
极阴走出房门，他准备去给厢房的年轻人上早课，正好看到了在药田中忙碌的宋文。
他也清晰的观察到宋文饱满的气血状态。
极阴精神一振。
“看来上次炼制的丹药极为成功，这小子的身体如此之快就恢复了，我得尽快开启新一炉丹药的炼制了。”
极阴一边默默的想到。
心情大好，他忍不住开口道。
““宋文，看来你的身体恢复得不错，为师心中甚为欣慰。有空的时候，多去外面走走，对身体康复大有裨益。”
说完，极阴也不等宋文回答，便脚步轻快的离去了。
宋文望着远去的极阴，心底有些奇怪，不知这老阴人今日发什么疯，如此兴奋。
忙碌完药田中的杂事后，日头已经快到头顶，宋文感觉肚中又有些饥饿，他将自己清洗一番后，便出了天煞帮。
看到一线生机的宋文，心情不错，决定出去犒劳一下自己。
天煞帮在盐城权势极大，盐城百姓衣食住行等诸多产业，都与天煞帮有着千丝万缕的联系。
尤其是天煞帮附近的商铺，但凡是规模大一点的，基本都是属于天煞帮的。
宋文不想去天煞帮的地盘吃饭，他径直走到了一家街边小摊。
小摊规模极小，就是临街搭建的摊子，在街边摆着三张桌子。
小摊上摆着一些煮熟的肉食，看上去还不错。小摊的生意不好，三张桌子都空着，宋文随便找了位置就坐了下去。
小铺的老板是一对年轻夫妻，丈夫正在处理着食材，妻子正在打扫桌子。
见到有客人来，年轻妇人加快了手中的动作，同时口中问道。
“客人，吃点什么？”

“多上一些肉食，炒两个小菜，再来一大碗面条。”宋文道。
“好得，客人稍等。”
年轻妇人闻言，面露喜色。
他们一家子，共有五口人，上有父母，下有三岁孩子，就靠这个小摊养活，但小摊的生意不好，日子过得甚为清贫。
从宋文的衣着，不难看出，是个不缺钱的主。
而且，看宋文点餐的架势，是个豪爽之人；应该能在宋文身上赚到不少的钱。
夫妻二人开始忙碌起来，年轻妇人切着卤肉，丈夫架锅烧火，准备炒菜。
不一会儿，年轻妇人就端过来两盘卤肉。
“客人，你先吃着，其他的马上就好。”
卤肉的味道不错，宋文很快就将眼前的两盘卤肉吃完了。
这时，年轻妇人端着个托盘，其上摆着面条和炒菜走了过来。
“再来两盘卤肉。”
“好得，客人。”年轻妇人放下面条和炒菜，笑着脸走开了。
正当宋文大快朵颐之时，又有三名汉子来到了小摊，在旁边空着的桌子坐下。
由于宋文是背对着这三人的，他的视线并没有瞧见三人长相，宋文也并不在意太过在意三人，只当是普通的路人。
这三人也点了一些卤肉和饭菜，很快年轻妇人就给三人端了上来。
content_en:
The second floor of the small building.
Ji Yin walked out of the room and was about to give morning lessons to the young people in the wing. He happened to see Song Wen busy in the medicine field.
He also clearly observed Song Wen's full energy and blood state.
Ji Yin perked up.
"It seems that the elixir refined last time was extremely successful. This kid's body recovered so quickly. I have to start refining a new batch of elixir as soon as possible."
Ji Yin thought silently.
He was in a good mood and couldn't help but speak.
""Song Wen, it seems that your body has recovered well, and I am very pleased. When you have free time, go outside for a walk more often, which will be of great benefit to your physical recovery. "
After saying that, Ji Yin left briskly without waiting for Song Wen's reply.
Song Wen looked at Ji Yin going away, feeling a little strange in his heart. He didn't know why this old Yin man was so crazy and excited today.
After finishing the chores in the medicine field, the sun was almost overhead, and Song Wen felt a little hungry again. After cleaning himself, he left the Tiansha Gang.
Seeing a glimmer of hope, Song Wen was in a good mood and decided to go out and reward himself.
The Tiansha Gang has great power in Yancheng. Many industries such as the people's clothing, food, housing and transportation in Yancheng are inextricably linked to the Tiansha Gang.
Especially the shops near the Tiansha Gang, any larger ones basically belong to the Tiansha Gang.
Song Wen didn't want to go to the Tiansha Gang's territory to eat, so he went straight to a street stall.
The stall is very small, just a stall facing the street, with three tables set up on the street.
There were some cooked meats on the stall, which looked pretty good. The stall's business was not good, and all three tables were empty. Song Wen casually found a seat and sat down.
The owners of the shop are a young couple. The husband is handling the ingredients and the wife is cleaning the table.
Seeing the guests coming, the young woman quickened her movements and asked at the same time.
"Guest, what do you want to eat? "
“Put in some more meat, stir-fry two side dishes, and have a big bowl of noodles. " Song Wendao.
"Okay, guest, wait a moment. "
When the young woman heard this, she beamed with joy.
There are five members of their family, including parents and a three-year-old child. They rely on this stall to support themselves. However, the stall's business is not good and they live in poverty.
From Song Wen's clothes, it is not difficult to tell that he is a man who is not short of money.
Moreover, judging from the way Song Wen orders food, he is a generous person; he should be able to make a lot of money from Song Wen.
The couple began to get busy. The young woman was cutting the braised pork, and the husband was setting a pot on the fire to prepare the vegetables.
After a while, the young woman brought over two plates of braised pork.
"Guest, you eat first, the rest will be ready soon. "
The braised pork tasted good, and Song Wen quickly finished the two plates of braised pork in front of him.
At this time, a young woman came over carrying a tray with noodles and stir-fried vegetables.
“Two more plates of braised pork. "
"Well done, guest. "The young woman put down the noodles and stir-fried vegetables and walked away with a smile on her face.
While Song Wen was enjoying his meal, three more men came to the stall and sat down at the empty table next to him.
Since Song Wen had his back to these three people, his eyes did not see the appearance of the three people. Song Wen did not care too much about the three people and just regarded them as ordinary passers-by.
The three people also ordered some braised pork and food, and soon the young woman served them to them.
